name: Mapping lab
summary: Hundreds of points across the map play a note when the data rises past a threshold. Choose what drives pitch, loudness and pan under More.
author: moran
description: About 300 grid points play a note when the data rises past a threshold. Choose what drives each part of the sound (pitch, loudness, pan, brightness, depth, attack, timbre family) from longitude, latitude, value or change, flip any mapping, try presets, and share the mapping by link. Click, tap or use the arrow keys to hear one point and how it was mapped; hovering only describes it.
